title: CELLSTYLEMAP rooted graph closure and staged DXF emission
mode: Generated in-memory extension-graph controls and focused adapter build

authoritativeReferences.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeReferences.finding: CELLSTYLEMAP is associated with TABLESTYLE through its extension dictionary and the ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_TABLESTYLE_CELLSTYLEMAP entry.

authoritativeReferences.title: LibreDWG DXF marker mapping and importer
authoritativeReferences.finding: Used only as a cross-implementation schema reference for the emitted CELLSTYLEMAP group markers; it does not establish native reader acceptance.

changes: Indexed typed CELLSTYLEMAP source handles in the extension-object graph and included them in duplicate-handle checks and graph inventory limits.

Accepted a map only as a unique child of the canonical TABLESTYLE extension-dictionary key, with the dictionary parent matching the unique TABLESTYLE xDictHandle owner and map.parentHandle matching that dictionary.

Rejected maps with unsupported own xdictionary/reactor references, wrong key or owner, aliases, and maps unreachable from the rooted graph; checked non-null text-style and linetype references resolve uniquely to their expected record types.
Staged validated CELLSTYLEMAP handles for preallocation and object emission after TABLESTYLE records.
Added generated positive and negative graph controls for valid closure, wrong key, wrong owner, and unreachable map. Kept the concrete adapter fail-closed gate unchanged.

validation.diffCheck: PASS: git diff --check scoped to dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h, and tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp

remainingLocalWork: Add a typed-plus-raw DXF CELLSTYLEMAP reader path and generated ASCII/Binary fileExport-to-readback graph roundtrip, then prove the exact output with an independent reader before changing support claims.
remainingExternalQualification: Native FreeCAD Linux and Windows route qualification

researchConclusion.resolved: The rooted graph preflight can now prove canonical TABLESTYLE extension-dictionary ownership and stage a single reachable CELLSTYLEMAP with unique text-style and linetype targets.
researchConclusion.unresolved: The adapter still refuses export before publication. The DXF typed/raw map reader, end-to-end fileExport/readback, independent-reader acceptance, and external qualification remain incomplete.
